subject: general
question: Select the wrongly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**prefunctory**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the error is in option 2. **
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is "perfunctory."**
 
 
• **"Perfunctory" means doing something without enthusiasm or thoroughness.**(असावधान)
 
• Example: I performed a few perfunctory twirls and made good my escape.
 
 
 
• The misspelled word "prefunctory" does not exist in the English language.
 
• The mistake is in the placement of the letter "r", which should come after the letter "u" instead of before it.

Hence,** the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Pernicious" means having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way.(हानिकारक)
 
• "Pariah" refers to an outcast or someone who is rejected by society.(ख़ारिज)
 
• "Peripheral" relates to something on the edge or outside of something else.(परिधीय)
